title: 20 April 1965: Filming: Help!
content:
The Beatles were at Twickenham Film Studios for work on Help! on this day.

Among the day’s scenes was the one where a follower of Kali-li attempted to remove the ring from Ringo Starr’s hand as he posted a letter. The interior shot was filmed on this day; the location work took place at South Western Road in Twickenham on 9 May 1965.

Page last updated: 17 May 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2016: Paul McCartney live: Rogers Arena, Vancouver
  • 1993: Paul McCartney live: Aggie Memorial Stadium, Las Cruces
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Maracanã Stadium, Rio de Janeiro
  • 1971: Yoko Ono locates her estranged daughter Kyoko
  • 1970: US album release: McCartney by Paul McCartney
  • 1969: Recording, mixing: I Want You (She’s So Heavy), Oh! Darling
  • 1969: The Beatles attempt to take ownership of Northern Songs
  • 1967: Recording, mixing: Sgt Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band (Reprise), Only A Northern Song
  • 1966: Recording, mixing: And Your Bird Can Sing, Taxman
  • 1964: Mixing: A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1964: Filming: Paul McCartney’s unused scene in A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Mersey View Pleasure Grounds, Frodsham
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Top Ten Club, Hamburg
